title: TVL_HISTORY
tagline: Total Value Locked in Timeswap Liquidity Pool. Charts of All the chains can be shown in the frames by selecting it
description:
The Dynamic TVL Dashboard is an innovative tool designed to provide real-time insights into the Total Value Locked (TVL) across Timeswap liquidity pools on various blockchain networks. It caters specifically to the DeFi and web3 community, offering a seamless integration into the Farcaster platform through an Open Frame interface.

Upon initiating the dashboard, users are prompted to select a blockchain network (e.g., Ethereum) of interest. This action triggers the display of a subsequent frame, showcasing a detailed and interactive chart that visually represents the fluctuation of TVL in the chosen network over time. The chart’s dynamic nature allows users to pinpoint specific timeframes, understand trends, and make informed decisions based on the liquidity pool's performance.
how_its_made:
Next.js: Utilized as the core framework for building the user interface, ensuring a responsive and interactive user experience optimized for web3 applications.
Canvas API: Employs this powerful drawing tool for creating dynamic, interactive charts that allow users to visualize and analyze the Total Value Locked (TVL) data over various timeframes.
DeFiLlama API: Serves as the primary data source, offering comprehensive and up-to-date information on liquidity pools across multiple blockchains, crucial for reflecting the latest market dynamics accurately.
Open Frames Protocol: Enables seamless integration with the Farcaster platform, allowing users to interact with the dashboard directly within their web3 social space, thus enhancing user engagement and experience.
